evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.reading: Abyssal Mask Curse = +12% amplifier, restricted to MAGIC damage, applied to every enemy champion in the 700-unit aura, and applied to damage from ALL sources (not just the wearer).

sources_quoted.quote: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.reading: Imperial Mandate Vulnerable = +7% amplifier on ALL damage types (physical, magic and true) from ALL sources, on an immobilized target, 4 s and extended by re-immobilization.

sources_quoted.quote: Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
sources_quoted.reading: The two amplifiers compose MULTIPLICATIVELY, not additively.

sources_quoted.quote: Damage type not reduced by resistances or almost all damage-reduction effects; still respects shields and invulnerability, is blocked by spell shields, and is affected by most damage amplifiers (except jungle-item/Smite/Ignite true damage).
sources_quoted.reading: True damage IS amplified by Vulnerable; it is not exempt.
Both items' cached values are current for patch 16.15; the 7% / 12% constants are not stale.

sources_quoted.quote: the mitigation operator `x -> x*100/(100+R)` is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance
sources_quoted.reading: Amplifiers commute with mitigation; applying an amp pre- or post-mitigation is numerically identical, so an ordering change cannot explain any part of the observed delta.

sourced_amplification_factors.cursed_and_vulnerable_physical_or_true_d: 1.07  (curse is magic-only per S1; Vulnerable covers all types per S2/S4)

independent_computation.step_1_scenario_inputs_unavailable: The input tuple for 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' (attacker, roster, levels, ranks, build, fight window) is defined outside the permitted evidence tree (it lives under scripts/). Neither data/ nor docs/math-foundations.md contains it: grep -r 'mandate_abyssal_curse_roster' over the export returns nothing, and data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json (22 scenarios) contains no Abyssal Mask / Imperial Mandate case. The absolute 3072.3 therefore cannot be re-derived end-to-end from the permitted sources; what CAN be derived exactly is the amplification law and the class of transition that the observed delta is and is not compatible with.

step_2_exclude_the_composition_rule_as_t.test: If the C3->C4 change were the additive->multiplicative fix (1.19 -> 1.1984, S3), the maximum possible increase is (1.1984-1.19)/1.19 = 0.70588%, attained only if 100% of the packet were magic damage.
step_2_exclude_the_composition_rule_as_t.conclusion: 1.66446% > 0.70588% => the change is NOT the amp-stacking rule. (Directly: solving M*(1.1984-1.19) = 50.3 gives M = 5988 of amplified magic damage, which already exceeds the whole 3072.3 packet - an impossibility.)

step_3_exclude_every_whole_packet_factor.test: Enumerate the ratio of every pair of sourced whole-packet factors from {1.0, 1.07, 1.12, 1.19, 1.1984}
step_3_exclude_every_whole_packet_factor.conclusion: No whole-packet factor swap produces 1.0166446. The C3->C4 change is necessarily a SCOPE change: a sub-portion of breakdown[2]'s damage moved from a narrower amplification regime into a broader one. Same test rules out the frozen baseline as a factor-swap of either tip (3269.6/3072.3 = 1.064219, 3269.6/3022.0 = 1.081932 - neither is a sourced factor ratio), so the frozen baseline is stale on some other axis as well.

step_4_size_the_rescoped_portion.if_a_7pct_Vulnerable_amp_was_newly_appli: 50.3 / 0.07 = 718.57 of post-mitigation damage (23.4% of the 3072.3 packet) previously unamplified by Mandate
step_4_size_the_rescoped_portion.if_a_12pct_Curse_amp_was_newly_applied: 50.3 / 0.12 = 419.17 of post-mitigation damage (13.6% of the packet) previously unamplified by Abyssal
step_4_size_the_rescoped_portion.conclusion: Every arithmetically admissible reading of the delta is 'a sourced amplifier is now reaching damage it was not reaching at the C3 tip'. C4 BROADENS amplifier scope; C3 withheld it.

independent_computation.step_5_rule_the_direction_against_the_so: Both item texts scope their amplifier with the same phrase - 'from all sources' (S1, S2) - and Mandate's Vulnerable is explicitly type-agnostic ('the damage they take', with true damage confirmed amplifiable by S4) and duration-extending on re-immobilization. Abyssal's Curse is likewise an aura over every enemy champion within 700 units, i.e. every roster member in range, not a single target. All three of these clauses are BROADENING clauses, and a coupled-roster scenario named for the curse exists precisely to pin them. A C3 tip that withheld a 7%/12% sourced amplifier from ~14-23% of a packet is a scope UNDER-application relative to the quoted text; the C4 value restores it. The only way the C4 value could instead be the wrong one is an over-application at the same sub-packet scale (e.g. the 12% Curse leaking onto physical basic attacks), which the quoted text forbids but which the permitted evidence tree cannot arbitrate without the scenario's damage-type split.
independent_computation.final: Correct value = the one that applies both sourced amplifiers at full scope, multiplicatively (1.07 on all damage of an immobilized target, x1.12 on its magic component). That is the larger value, 3072.3. The frozen baseline 3269.6 is excluded: it exceeds the C4 value by 6.42%, which is not any sourced factor ratio, so it cannot be recovered by any legal combination of the 7% and 12% amplifiers.

caveats: The scenario input tuple is outside the permitted evidence tree; the absolute number 3072.3 was NOT reproduced arithmetically end-to-end. What was verified independently: (a) the two amplifier constants and their scope text, current for patch 16.15; (b) that they compose multiplicatively; (c) that the observed C3->C4 delta is arithmetically incompatible with an additive->multiplicative fix and with every whole-packet factor swap; (d) that the delta is therefore a scope broadening, which is the direction the quoted item text prescribes.

Residual risk: a sub-packet over-application in C4 (Curse leaking onto non-magic damage) would produce a delta of the same size and sign. Discriminating it requires the scenario's per-damage-type split, which is not in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md.

Recommended confirmation for whoever holds the scenario: check whether breakdown[2]'s newly amplified 419.2 (or 718.6) of post-mitigation damage is magic (Curse-eligible) or physical/true (Mandate-only). If it is physical/true and the 12% Curse touched it, the verdict flips.
